meta.parties: Lebbe Marikar v. Sainu Et Al

rules.statement: A person who enters into possession of land under an agreement with the owners to sell the same to him cannot acquire title by prescription after the lapse of ten years, his possession not being adverse to the true owners.
rules.supporting_quote: In Naguda Marikar v. Mohammadu1 the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council held that where a person enters on another's land as his agent he cannot claim a title by prescription, unless he can show that he has changed his character from agent to owner, and that he had possession as such owner for a period of ten years.
